task-review-requests.title: Review responsibility
task-review-requests.boundary: A request names a responsible reviewer. It grants no permission and does not prove quality. Any currently authorized reviewer can still use the original acceptance flow.
task-review-requests.binding_changed: The direct task/run binding changed. This request remains in history; it does not establish current acceptance evidence.
task-review-requests.reviewer_unavailabl: The named person is no longer a currently eligible reviewer.
task-review-requests.decision_unavailabl: The original Review source cannot be confirmed. No decision is inferred.
task-review-requests.access_changed: Access changed. Private task and review-request facts have been cleared.
task-review-requests.no_pending: No review responsibility request is pending for this task.
task-review-requests.draft_storage: The local draft state could not be saved. Keep this page open and retry before leaving.
task-review-requests.invalid_draft: A saved draft could not be read. Its original bytes remain; clear it explicitly before composing again.
task-review-requests.confirmed: The original operation was confirmed. Current facts are read again separately.
task-review-requests.run_required: A current succeeded bound run is required to locate a new request. Full quality gates are still checked by the original Review.
task-review-requests.draft_basis_changed: The draft keeps its original task/run versions. Confirm the current binding explicitly before sending a new request.
task-review-requests.adopt_basis: Confirm which exact task/run versions this request refers to.
task-review-requests.cancel_changed: This request changed. Clear this cancellation draft and read its current state before creating another command.
task-review-requests.invalid_query: Use at most 200 characters without control characters.
task-review-requests.no_targets: No currently eligible reviewers match this search.
task-review-requests.invalid_read: The current review-request source could not be confirmed. Retry this read.
task-review-requests.page_changed: The collection changed while loading. Refresh from the first page.
task-review-requests.refresh_failed: The current request basis could not be read. Retry before making a new command.
task-review-requests.draft_guard: A draft or original request is still pending. Send, clear or reconcile it before leaving.
task-review-requests.notification: You were asked to review a task delivery
task-review-requests.inbox_intro: Task assignments, discussion mentions and review requests for you in the current project.
task-review-requests.inbox_empty_hint: New assignments, explicit mentions and review requests appear here. Earlier events are not backfilled.
